method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (taa-core.l4: dates with built-in date functions only, the Act's printed figures, and the rules) and one seat layer that restates no rule (taa-seat.l4, 49 questions with @export and @desc); the amounts s 61 varies each 1 July are inputs, since no statement of the varied amounts is deposited; five regulative rules (s 70(1) with s 70(3); s 70(4); s 64(1) with ss 65(2), 66; ss 49(4), 50(4), 51(5); s 46A(1A)), tested by EVALTRACE, never taken as inputs; no REFUSE (a case outside the encoding answers NOTHING, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
